name: Wings
overview: Scripture uses wings as a powerful symbol of God's protection, care, and strength. The cherubim on the mercy seat stretch their wings over the holy place, signifying divine presence and shelter (Exodus 25:20), while believers are invited to trust under God's wings, finding refuge and reward (Ruth 2:12; Psalms 91:4). The imagery of mounting up with wings as eagles conveys renewed strength and perseverance for those who wait on the Lord (Isaiah 40:31), highlighting both God's sustaining power and the believer's dependence on Him.
